# interim-validation-notes

**目的**：QGISでの中間検証方法を明文化する。  
**達成指標**：確認すべきレイヤ、属性、ラスタ、判断基準がRmd上で確認できる。

## 中間検証結果の確認方法

このRmdでは、GeoPackageは `final` 側に集約して出力する。  
ただし、中間検証用レイヤはレイヤ名に `interim_` を付け、最終成果レイヤと区別する。

GPKGの出力先：

```text
auto-cor-results/final/gpkg/supported_autocorrelation_outputs.gpkg
```

主に確認するレイヤは以下である。

| レイヤ名 | 意味 | 検証すべき事項 |
|---|---|---|
| `interim_dwelling_points_grouped` | 住居点ごとのmicro cluster分類とmacro cluster割当 | `interim_group_type`、`group_id`、`group_size`、`macro_cluster_id` を確認する。 |
| `interim_group_geometries` | micro clusterの範囲 | 局所的な密集単位が過大・過小でないか確認する。 |
| `interim_macro_cluster_geometries` | 統合後のmacro cluster範囲 | C1・C2・C8・C30など、考古学的に一つの集落構造とみなすべき範囲が同一macro clusterに入るか確認する。 |
| `interim_macro_cluster_link_edges` | macro統合の根拠となるクラスタ間リンク | どのmicro cluster同士が統合されたか、リンクが過剰・不足していないか確認する。 |
| `interim_internal_void_candidates` | macro cluster内の内部空白域・広場候補 | 内部空白域が単純な非検出域ではなく、環状・馬蹄形集落の中央空間として解釈できるか確認する。 |
| `interim_grid_status` | 10mグリッドのpresence/absence/no_data | 調査済み非検出域と未調査域の分布確認に用いる。 |

中間検証用ラスタの出力先：

```text
auto-cor-results/interim/raster/
```

| ラスタ名 | 意味 | 検証すべき事項 |
|---|---|---|
| `interim_absence_penalty_50m.tif` | 周辺50mに調査済み非検出域がどれだけ存在するか | 小規模住居群の周囲で高い場合、孤立的住居として評価しやすい。macro cluster内部の高値は広場・内部空白域の可能性も検討する。 |
| `interim_open_no_data_score_100m.tif` | 周辺100mに未調査域がどれだけ開いているか | 密集範囲がno_data側へ連続する可能性を確認する。 |

検証で問題がなければ、`analysis-parameters` chunk の `proceed_to_final_model <- TRUE` に変更して、finalモデル構築へ進む。

# final-validation-gate

**目的**：中間検証後にfinalモデルへ進むかを明示的に制御する。  
**達成指標**：`proceed_to_final_model` がFALSEの場合、finalモデル構築はスキップされる。

```{r final-validation-gate}
if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、finalモデル構築はここで停止します。")
  message("QGISでinterim出力を確認後、analysis-parameters chunkでTRUEに変更してください。")
} else {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = TRUE のため、finalモデル構築へ進みます。")
}
```

# compute-macro-isolation-support

**目的**：macro clusterごとに孤立度と集落連続性への寄与度を計算する。  
**達成指標**：`macro_group_geometries_final` と `macro_support_table` が作成される。

```{r compute-macro-isolation-support}
if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、このchunkをスキップします。")
} else {
  compute_ring_stats_one <- function(group_sf, grid_sf, inner_m, outer_m) {
    outer <- sf::st_buffer(sf::st_geometry(group_sf), outer_m)
    inner <- sf::st_buffer(sf::st_geometry(group_sf), inner_m)
    ring <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_difference(outer, inner))
    ring <- sf::st_make_valid(ring)
    context <- compute_polygon_context(ring, grid_sf)

    tibble::tibble(
      macro_cluster_id = group_sf$macro_cluster_id,
      isolation_ring_inner_m = inner_m,
      isolation_ring_outer_m = outer_m
    ) |>
      dplyr::bind_cols(context)
  }

  isolation_ring_inner_m <- selected_d_adj_safe_m
  isolation_ring_outer_m <- max(3 * selected_d_adj_safe_m, 50)

  macro_centroids <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(macro_group_geometries_interim))

  if (nrow(macro_centroids) >= 2) {
    macro_dist <- as.matrix(sf::st_distance(macro_centroids))
    diag(macro_dist) <- NA_real_
    nearest_macro_distance_m <- apply(macro_dist, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    nearest_macro_distance_m <- Inf
  }

  macro_ring_stats <- purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_len(nrow(macro_group_geometries_interim)),
    function(i) {
      compute_ring_stats_one(
        macro_group_geometries_interim[i, ],
        grid10,
        inner_m = isolation_ring_inner_m,
        outer_m = isolation_ring_outer_m
      )
    }
  )

  macro_support_table <- macro_group_geometries_interim |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      nearest_macro_distance_m = nearest_macro_distance_m
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(macro_ring_stats, by = "macro_cluster_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      small_size_factor = clamp01_numeric(
        (dense_cluster_min_n - n_dwellings) /
          max(dense_cluster_min_n - small_cluster_max_n, 1)
      ),
      spacing_factor = clamp01_numeric(
        nearest_macro_distance_m / max(selected_d_adj_safe_m * 3, 1)
      ),
      absence_enclosure_factor = clamp01_numeric(absence_ratio_in_surveyed),
      surveyed_coverage_factor = clamp01_numeric(surveyed_ratio),
      isolation_score = clamp01_numeric(
        small_size_factor *
          spacing_factor *
          absence_enclosure_factor *
          surveyed_coverage_factor
      ),
      size_support_factor = clamp01_numeric(
        (n_dwellings - small_cluster_max_n) /
          max(dense_cluster_min_n - small_cluster_max_n, 1)
      ),
      macro_structure_bonus = dplyr::case_when(
        macro_group_type == "macro_settlement_complex_candidate" ~ 0.90,
        macro_group_type == "single_dense_micro_cluster" ~ 0.75,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      cluster_support = clamp01_numeric(
        pmax(size_support_factor, macro_structure_bonus) *
          (1 - isolation_score)
      ),
      isolated_dwelling_weight = clamp01_numeric(isolation_score)
    )

  macro_group_geometries_final <- macro_group_geometries_interim |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      macro_support_table,
      by = c(
        "macro_cluster_id",
        "micro_group_ids",
        "n_micro_groups",
        "n_dwellings",
        "n_dense_micro_groups",
        "n_intermediate_micro_groups",
        "n_small_micro_groups",
        "macro_group_type",
        "selected_eps_m",
        "selected_min_pts",
        "selected_d_adj_m",
        "selected_d_adj_safe_m",
        "macro_hull_buffer_m",
        "macro_link_max_boundary_distance_m",
        "macro_nearest_dwelling_link_m",
        "macro_corridor_width_m"
      )
    )

  dwelling_points_final <- dwelling_points_grouped_macro |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      macro_support_table |>
        dplyr::select(
          macro_cluster_id,
          macro_group_type,
          isolation_score,
          cluster_support,
          isolated_dwelling_weight
        ),
      by = "macro_cluster_id"
    )

  readr::write_csv(
    macro_support_table,
    file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_macro_cluster_support.csv")
  )

  print(
    macro_support_table |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cluster_support))
  )
}
```

# build-supported-rasters

**目的**：macro cluster supportを用いて、支持付き近接・密度・open no_data成分をラスタ化する。  
**達成指標**：final scoreの構成成分ラスタが作成される。

```{r build-supported-rasters}
if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、このchunkをスキップします。")
} else {
  dwelling_points_for_weight <- dwelling_points_final |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      point_cluster_support = tidyr::replace_na(cluster_support, 0),
      point_isolated_weight = tidyr::replace_na(isolated_dwelling_weight, 0)
    )

  supported_dwelling_count_r <- terra::rasterize(
    terra::vect(dwelling_points_for_weight),
    template_r,
    field = "point_cluster_support",
    fun = "sum",
    background = 0
  )
  names(supported_dwelling_count_r) <- "supported_dwelling_count"

  isolated_dwelling_count_r <- terra::rasterize(
    terra::vect(dwelling_points_for_weight),
    template_r,
    field = "point_isolated_weight",
    fun = "sum",
    background = 0
  )
  names(isolated_dwelling_count_r) <- "isolated_dwelling_count"

  supported_density_raw_50m_r <- focal_sum_circle(supported_dwelling_count_r, 50)
  supported_density_score_50m_r <- scale01_raster(log1p(supported_density_raw_50m_r))
  names(supported_density_score_50m_r) <- "supported_density_score_50m"

  proximity_decay_m <- max(2 * selected_d_adj_safe_m, 50)
  macro_sources <- macro_group_geometries_final |>
    dplyr::filter(cluster_support > 0.01) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cluster_support))

  macro_max_proximity_sources <- 200
  if (nrow(macro_sources) > macro_max_proximity_sources) {
    macro_sources <- macro_sources |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = macro_max_proximity_sources)
  }

  if (nrow(macro_sources) == 0) {
    supported_cluster_proximity_score_r <- template_r * 0
  } else {
    prox_rasters <- vector("list", nrow(macro_sources))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(macro_sources))) {
      one_macro <- macro_sources[i, ]
      one_support <- one_macro$cluster_support[1]

      one_r <- terra::rasterize(
        terra::vect(one_macro),
        template_r,
        field = 1,
        background = NA
      )

      dist_r <- terra::distance(one_r)
      prox_rasters[[i]] <- one_support * exp(-dist_r / proximity_decay_m)
    }

    supported_cluster_proximity_score_r <- terra::app(
      do.call(c, prox_rasters),
      fun = max,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  supported_cluster_proximity_score_r <- terra::clamp(
    na0_raster(supported_cluster_proximity_score_r),
    lower = 0,
    upper = 1,
    values = TRUE
  )
  names(supported_cluster_proximity_score_r) <- "supported_cluster_proximity_score"

  effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r <-
    open_no_data_score_100m_r *
    supported_cluster_proximity_score_r *
    no_data_binary_r

  effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r <- terra::clamp(
    effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r,
    lower = 0,
    upper = 1,
    values = TRUE
  )
  names(effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r) <- "effective_open_no_data_score_100m"

  isolated_dwelling_signal_r <- scale01_raster(
    focal_sum_circle(isolated_dwelling_count_r, 50)
  )
  names(isolated_dwelling_signal_r) <- "isolated_dwelling_signal"

  print(terra::global(supported_cluster_proximity_score_r, c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE))
  print(terra::global(supported_density_score_50m_r, c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

# build-final-continuity-score

**目的**：macro cluster supportに基づく連続量の自己相関スコアを作成する。  
**達成指標**：`cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r` と `cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r` が作成される。

```{r build-final-continuity-score}
# 目的：
# ユークリッド距離＋有限距離減衰を基準スコアとし、
# local absence evidence によって抑制した検証用スコアを作成する。
#
# 達成指標：
# 1. euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r が作成される。
# 2. absence_evidence_50m_r / absence_evidence_100m_r / absence_evidence_combined_r が作成される。
# 3. absence suppression の強度違いを比較できる複数ラスタが作成される。
# 4. cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r には soft_p4 版を入れる。

if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、final score の作成をスキップします。")
} else {

  if (!exists("template_r")) {
    stop("template_r が存在しません。create-analysis-grid chunkを確認してください。")
  }

  if (!exists("grid10_status")) {
    stop("grid10_status が存在しません。rasterize-status-layers chunkを確認してください。")
  }

  if (!exists("rasterize_grid_field")) {
    stop("rasterize_grid_field が存在しません。setup chunkを確認してください。")
  }

  if (!exists("clamp01_raster")) {
    clamp01_raster <- function(r) {
      terra::ifel(r < 0, 0, terra::ifel(r > 1, 1, r))
    }
  }

  raster_na_to_zero <- function(r) {
    terra::ifel(is.na(r), 0, r)
  }

  selected_d_adj_safe_m <- 25

  if (
    exists("selected_d_adj_m") &&
      length(selected_d_adj_m) == 1 &&
      is.finite(selected_d_adj_m)
  ) {
    selected_d_adj_safe_m <- selected_d_adj_m
  }

  # 距離減衰パラメータ
  euclidean_max_distance_m <- max(3 * selected_d_adj_safe_m, 80)
  euclidean_decay_power <- 2

  # absence evidence 抑制パラメータ
  absence_soft_power_moderate <- 2
  absence_soft_power_strong <- 4
  absence_hard_threshold_low <- 0.25
  absence_hard_threshold_high <- 0.35
  absence_100m_weight <- 0.5

  cat("euclidean_max_distance_m:", euclidean_max_distance_m, "\n")
  cat("euclidean_decay_power:", euclidean_decay_power, "\n")
  cat("absence_soft_power_moderate:", absence_soft_power_moderate, "\n")
  cat("absence_soft_power_strong:", absence_soft_power_strong, "\n")
  cat("absence_hard_threshold_low:", absence_hard_threshold_low, "\n")
  cat("absence_hard_threshold_high:", absence_hard_threshold_high, "\n")
  cat("absence_100m_weight:", absence_100m_weight, "\n")

  # no_data flag
  if (!exists("no_data_flag_r")) {
    no_data_flag_r <- rasterize_grid_field(
      grid10_status,
      "no_data_flag",
      template_r,
      background = 0,
      touches = TRUE
    )
    names(no_data_flag_r) <- "no_data_flag"
  }

  # city mask
  if (exists("city_mask_r")) {
    city_allowed_r <- terra::ifel(is.na(city_mask_r), 0, 1)
  } else {
    city_allowed_r <- template_r
    city_allowed_r[] <- 1
  }
  names(city_allowed_r) <- "city_allowed"

  # 伝播発信源。
  # macro clusterがあれば優先し、なければgroup_geometries_final、さらに無ければgroup_geometries_interimを使う。
  if (
    exists("macro_group_geometries_interim") &&
      nrow(macro_group_geometries_interim) > 0 &&
      "macro_group_type" %in% names(macro_group_geometries_interim)
  ) {
    source_geoms <- macro_group_geometries_interim |>
      dplyr::filter(
        macro_group_type %in% c(
          "macro_settlement_complex_candidate",
          "single_dense_micro_cluster"
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        source_seed = 1L,
        source_type = macro_group_type
      )

    source_object_used <- "macro_group_geometries_interim"

  } else if (
    exists("group_geometries_final") &&
      nrow(group_geometries_final) > 0 &&
      "cluster_support" %in% names(group_geometries_final)
  ) {
    source_geoms <- group_geometries_final |>
      dplyr::filter(
        cluster_support > 0,
        n_dwellings >= dense_cluster_min_n
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        source_seed = 1L,
        source_type = "supported_group"
      )

    source_object_used <- "group_geometries_final"

  } else if (
    exists("group_geometries_interim") &&
      nrow(group_geometries_interim) > 0 &&
      "interim_group_type" %in% names(group_geometries_interim)
  ) {
    source_geoms <- group_geometries_interim |>
      dplyr::filter(
        interim_group_type == "dense_candidate"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        source_seed = 1L,
        source_type = "dense_candidate"
      )

    source_object_used <- "group_geometries_interim"

  } else {
    stop("伝播発信源に使えるcluster geometryが存在しません。")
  }

  cat("source_object_used:", source_object_used, "\n")
  cat("source cluster count:", nrow(source_geoms), "\n")

  propagation_source_seed_r <- template_r
  propagation_source_seed_r[] <- 0
  names(propagation_source_seed_r) <- "propagation_source_seed"

  if (nrow(source_geoms) > 0) {
    propagation_source_seed_r <- terra::rasterize(
      terra::vect(source_geoms),
      template_r,
      field = "source_seed",
      background = 0,
      touches = TRUE
    )
    names(propagation_source_seed_r) <- "propagation_source_seed"
  } else {
    warning("伝播発信源が0件です。以後のスコアは0になります。")
  }

  # ユークリッド距離
  source_seed_na_r <- terra::ifel(
    propagation_source_seed_r == 1,
    1,
    NA_real_
  )
  names(source_seed_na_r) <- "source_seed_for_distance"

  euclidean_distance_from_source_r <- terra::distance(source_seed_na_r)
  names(euclidean_distance_from_source_r) <- "euclidean_distance_from_source_m"

  # 有限距離減衰
  euclidean_compact_distance_score_r <- terra::ifel(
    is.na(euclidean_distance_from_source_r),
    0,
    terra::ifel(
      euclidean_distance_from_source_r > euclidean_max_distance_m,
      0,
      (1 - euclidean_distance_from_source_r / euclidean_max_distance_m) ^
        euclidean_decay_power
    )
  )

  euclidean_compact_distance_score_r <- clamp01_raster(
    euclidean_compact_distance_score_r
  )
  names(euclidean_compact_distance_score_r) <- "euclidean_compact_distance_score"

  # 基準スコア：ユークリッド距離＋有限距離減衰＋no_data限定
  euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r <-
    euclidean_compact_distance_score_r *
    no_data_flag_r *
    city_allowed_r

  euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r <- clamp01_raster(
    euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r
  )
  names(euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r) <- "euclidean_compact_score_no_data"

  # absence evidence 50m
  if (exists("absence_penalty_50m_r")) {
    absence_evidence_50m_r <- absence_penalty_50m_r
  } else if (
    exists("local_absence_ratio_rasters") &&
      "50" %in% names(local_absence_ratio_rasters)
  ) {
    absence_evidence_50m_r <- local_absence_ratio_rasters[["50"]]
  } else {
    stop("absence_evidence_50m_r の材料がありません。absence_penalty_50m_r または local_absence_ratio_rasters[['50']] を確認してください。")
  }

  absence_evidence_50m_r <- raster_na_to_zero(absence_evidence_50m_r)
  absence_evidence_50m_r <- clamp01_raster(absence_evidence_50m_r)
  names(absence_evidence_50m_r) <- "absence_evidence_50m"

  # absence evidence 100m
  if (
    exists("local_absence_ratio_rasters") &&
      "100" %in% names(local_absence_ratio_rasters)
  ) {
    absence_evidence_100m_r <- local_absence_ratio_rasters[["100"]]
    absence_evidence_100m_r <- raster_na_to_zero(absence_evidence_100m_r)
    absence_evidence_100m_r <- clamp01_raster(absence_evidence_100m_r)
  } else {
    absence_evidence_100m_r <- absence_evidence_50m_r
  }

  names(absence_evidence_100m_r) <- "absence_evidence_100m"

  # 50mを主、100mを補助として使う。
  # 100mは広すぎる抑制を避けるため 0.5倍してから最大値を取る。
  absence_evidence_100m_weighted_r <-
    absence_evidence_100m_r * absence_100m_weight

  absence_evidence_combined_r <- terra::ifel(
    absence_evidence_50m_r >= absence_evidence_100m_weighted_r,
    absence_evidence_50m_r,
    absence_evidence_100m_weighted_r
  )

  absence_evidence_combined_r <- clamp01_raster(absence_evidence_combined_r)
  names(absence_evidence_combined_r) <- "absence_evidence_combined"

  make_absence_suppressed_score <- function(
    base_score_r,
    absence_evidence_r,
    soft_power = 2,
    hard_threshold = NULL
  ) {
    evidence_r <- raster_na_to_zero(absence_evidence_r)
    evidence_r <- clamp01_raster(evidence_r)

    suppression_multiplier_r <- (1 - evidence_r) ^ soft_power
    suppression_multiplier_r <- clamp01_raster(suppression_multiplier_r)

    if (!is.null(hard_threshold)) {
      suppression_multiplier_r <- terra::ifel(
        evidence_r >= hard_threshold,
        0,
        suppression_multiplier_r
      )
    }

    out_r <- base_score_r * suppression_multiplier_r
    out_r <- clamp01_raster(out_r)

    out_r
  }

  # soft suppression：緩やか
  euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r <-
    make_absence_suppressed_score(
      base_score_r = euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
      absence_evidence_r = absence_evidence_combined_r,
      soft_power = absence_soft_power_moderate,
      hard_threshold = NULL
    )

  names(euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r) <-
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data"

  # soft suppression：強め。今回の主検証候補。
  euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r <-
    make_absence_suppressed_score(
      base_score_r = euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
      absence_evidence_r = absence_evidence_combined_r,
      soft_power = absence_soft_power_strong,
      hard_threshold = NULL
    )

  names(euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r) <-
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data"

  # hybrid suppression：threshold 0.25
  euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r <-
    make_absence_suppressed_score(
      base_score_r = euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
      absence_evidence_r = absence_evidence_combined_r,
      soft_power = absence_soft_power_moderate,
      hard_threshold = absence_hard_threshold_low
    )

  names(euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r) <-
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data"

  # hybrid suppression：threshold 0.35
  euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r <-
    make_absence_suppressed_score(
      base_score_r = euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
      absence_evidence_r = absence_evidence_combined_r,
      soft_power = absence_soft_power_moderate,
      hard_threshold = absence_hard_threshold_high
    )

  names(euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r) <-
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data"

  # 今回の検証用final scoreには、急な断絶を作らない soft_p4 を入れる。
  cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r <-
    euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r

  names(cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r) <-
    "cluster_continuity_score_all_cells"

  cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r <- terra::ifel(
    no_data_flag_r == 1,
    cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r,
    NA_real_
  )

  names(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r) <-
    "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"

  final_score_formula <- tibble::tibble(
    output = c(
      "euclidean_compact_score_no_data",
      "absence_evidence_50m",
      "absence_evidence_100m",
      "absence_evidence_combined",
      "euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data",
      "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data",
      "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data",
      "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data",
      "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"
    ),
    meaning = c(
      "ユークリッド距離＋有限距離減衰の基準スコア",
      "50m局所absence evidence",
      "100m局所absence evidence",
      "50mを主、100mを補助にしたabsence evidence",
      "absence evidenceによる緩やかな連続抑制",
      "absence evidenceによる強めの連続抑制。今回の主検証候補",
      "absence evidence 0.25以上を0にする強いhybrid抑制",
      "absence evidence 0.35以上を0にする中程度hybrid抑制",
      "今回検証用の最終スコア。soft_p4版と同一"
    )
  )

  print(final_score_formula)

  final_components_stack <- c(
    propagation_source_seed_r,
    euclidean_distance_from_source_r,
    euclidean_compact_distance_score_r,
    euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
    absence_evidence_50m_r,
    absence_evidence_100m_r,
    absence_evidence_combined_r,
    euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r,
    euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r,
    euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r,
    euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r,
    cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r
  )

  names(final_components_stack) <- c(
    "propagation_source_seed",
    "euclidean_distance_from_source_m",
    "euclidean_compact_distance_score",
    "euclidean_compact_score_no_data",
    "absence_evidence_50m",
    "absence_evidence_100m",
    "absence_evidence_combined",
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data",
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data",
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data",
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data",
    "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"
  )
}
```

```{r absence-evidence-score-diagnostics}
# 目的：
# 距離減衰 + absence evidence 抑制の効果を数値診断する。
#
# 達成指標：
# 基準スコア、soft抑制、hybrid抑制の正値セル数・弱シグナル比率・分位がCSV出力される。

if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、absence evidence diagnostics をスキップします。")
} else {

  required_rasters <- c(
    "euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r",
    "absence_evidence_50m_r",
    "absence_evidence_100m_r",
    "absence_evidence_combined_r",
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r",
    "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r",
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r",
    "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r",
    "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r"
  )

  missing_rasters <- required_rasters[
    !vapply(required_rasters, exists, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(missing_rasters) > 0) {
    stop(
      "必要なラスタが存在しません: ",
      paste(missing_rasters, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  summarise_score_values <- function(r, label) {
    vals <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]

    if (length(vals) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        score_layer = label,
        n_values = 0,
        n_positive = 0,
        n_low_positive_0_to_0_1 = 0,
        low_positive_ratio = NA_real_,
        min = NA_real_,
        q25 = NA_real_,
        median = NA_real_,
        q75 = NA_real_,
        max = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    n_positive <- sum(vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_low_positive <- sum(vals > 0 & vals < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble::tibble(
      score_layer = label,
      n_values = length(vals),
      n_positive = n_positive,
      n_low_positive_0_to_0_1 = n_low_positive,
      low_positive_ratio = ifelse(
        n_positive > 0,
        n_low_positive / n_positive,
        NA_real_
      ),
      min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
      median = stats::median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
      max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  absence_score_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise_score_values(
      euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r,
      "euclidean_compact_score_no_data"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      absence_evidence_50m_r,
      "absence_evidence_50m"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      absence_evidence_100m_r,
      "absence_evidence_100m"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      absence_evidence_combined_r,
      "absence_evidence_combined"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r,
      "euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r,
      "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r,
      "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r,
      "euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data"
    ),
    summarise_score_values(
      cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r,
      "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"
    )
  )

  print(absence_score_summary)

  absence_parameter_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    parameter = c(
      "selected_d_adj_safe_m",
      "euclidean_max_distance_m",
      "euclidean_decay_power",
      "absence_soft_power_moderate",
      "absence_soft_power_strong",
      "absence_hard_threshold_low",
      "absence_hard_threshold_high",
      "absence_100m_weight",
      "final_score_selected"
    ),
    value = c(
      as.character(selected_d_adj_safe_m),
      as.character(euclidean_max_distance_m),
      as.character(euclidean_decay_power),
      as.character(absence_soft_power_moderate),
      as.character(absence_soft_power_strong),
      as.character(absence_hard_threshold_low),
      as.character(absence_hard_threshold_high),
      as.character(absence_100m_weight),
      "euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data"
    )
  )

  print(absence_parameter_summary)

  if (exists("final_csv_dir")) {
    dir.create(final_csv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    readr::write_csv(
      absence_score_summary,
      file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_absence_evidence_score_diagnostics.csv")
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      absence_parameter_summary,
      file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_absence_evidence_score_parameters.csv")
    )
  }
}
```

    ),
    value = c(
      selected_d_adj_safe_m,

  print(euclidean_parameter_summary)

  if (exists("final_csv_dir")) {

```{r propagation-score-diagnostics, eval=FALSE}
# 目的：
# barrier + compact propagation 型スコアの分布を診断する。
#
# 達成指標：
# 到達可能no_dataセル数、距離範囲、スコア分位がCSVに出力される。

if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、propagation diagnostics をスキップします。")
} else {

  required_rasters <- c(
    "barrier_connected_no_data_r",
    "propagation_distance_from_source_r",
    "compact_distance_score_r",
    "barrier_compact_propagation_score_r",
    "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r"
  )

  missing_rasters <- required_rasters[
    !vapply(required_rasters, exists, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(missing_rasters) > 0) {
    stop(
      "必要なラスタが存在しません: ",
      paste(missing_rasters, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  connected_vals <- terra::values(
    barrier_connected_no_data_r,
    mat = FALSE
  )

  dist_vals <- terra::values(
    propagation_distance_from_source_r,
    mat = FALSE
  )

  score_vals <- terra::values(
    cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r,
    mat = FALSE
  )

  connected_no_data_count <- sum(
    connected_vals == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  score_positive_count <- sum(
    score_vals > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  score_positive_low_count <- sum(
    score_vals > 0 & score_vals < 0.1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  score_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    metric = c(
      "connected_no_data_count",
      "score_positive_count",
      "score_positive_low_count_0_to_0_1",
      "positive_low_ratio",
      "distance_min_m",
      "distance_q25_m",
      "distance_median_m",
      "distance_q75_m",
      "distance_max_m",
      "score_min",
      "score_q25",
      "score_median",
      "score_q75",
      "score_max"
    ),
    value = c(
      connected_no_data_count,
      score_positive_count,
      score_positive_low_count,
      ifelse(score_positive_count > 0, score_positive_low_count / score_positive_count, NA_real_),
      suppressWarnings(min(dist_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::quantile(dist_vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))),
      suppressWarnings(stats::median(dist_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::quantile(dist_vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))),
      suppressWarnings(max(dist_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(min(score_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::quantile(score_vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))),
      suppressWarnings(stats::median(score_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::quantile(score_vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))),
      suppressWarnings(max(score_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  )

  print(score_summary)

  if (exists("final_csv_dir")) {
    dir.create(final_csv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    readr::write_csv(
      score_summary,
      file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_barrier_compact_propagation_score_summary.csv")
    )
  }
}
```

# export-final-rasters

**目的**：QGIS表示用の最終ラスタと構成要素ラスタをGeoTIFFで出力する。  
**達成指標**：連続値スコアと診断用成分ラスタが `final/raster` に作成される。

```{r export-final-rasters}
# 目的：
# QGIS表示用の最終ラスタと診断ラスタをGeoTIFFで出力する。
#
# 達成指標：
# 距離減衰 + absence evidence 抑制版、その比較用成分が final/raster に出力される。
# 旧検証用のBFS伝播ラスタ・単純barrierラスタは削除される。

if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、final raster 出力をスキップします。")
} else {

  if (!exists("final_raster_dir")) {
    stop("final_raster_dir が存在しません。paths chunkを確認してください。")
  }

  dir.create(final_raster_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # 不採用になった旧検証ラスタを削除する。
  obsolete_final_rasters <- c(
    "final_barrier_connected_no_data.tif",
    "final_propagation_distance_from_source_m.tif",
    "final_compact_distance_score.tif",
    "final_barrier_compact_propagation_score.tif",
    "final_euclidean_barrier_connected_no_data.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_barrier_allowed.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_barrier_patch.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_barrier_score_no_data.tif"
  )

  obsolete_paths <- file.path(final_raster_dir, obsolete_final_rasters)

  if (any(file.exists(obsolete_paths))) {
    unlink(obsolete_paths[file.exists(obsolete_paths)])
    cat("obsolete validation rasters removed:\n")
    print(obsolete_paths[file.exists(obsolete_paths)])
  }

  raster_outputs <- list()

  # 従来成分：比較・診断用として残す
  if (exists("supported_cluster_proximity_score_r")) {
    raster_outputs$supported_cluster_proximity_score <- supported_cluster_proximity_score_r
  }

  if (exists("supported_density_score_50m_r")) {
    raster_outputs$supported_density_score_50m <- supported_density_score_50m_r
  }

  if (exists("effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r")) {
    raster_outputs$effective_open_no_data_score_100m <- effective_open_no_data_score_100m_r
  }

  if (exists("absence_penalty_50m_r")) {
    raster_outputs$absence_penalty_50m <- absence_penalty_50m_r
  }

  if (exists("isolated_dwelling_signal_r")) {
    raster_outputs$isolated_dwelling_signal <- isolated_dwelling_signal_r
  }

  # 今回の距離減衰 + absence evidence 検証用成分
  if (exists("propagation_source_seed_r")) {
    raster_outputs$propagation_source_seed <- propagation_source_seed_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_distance_from_source_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_distance_from_source_m <- euclidean_distance_from_source_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_compact_distance_score_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_compact_distance_score <- euclidean_compact_distance_score_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_compact_score_no_data <- euclidean_compact_score_no_data_r
  }

  if (exists("absence_evidence_50m_r")) {
    raster_outputs$absence_evidence_50m <- absence_evidence_50m_r
  }

  if (exists("absence_evidence_100m_r")) {
    raster_outputs$absence_evidence_100m <- absence_evidence_100m_r
  }

  if (exists("absence_evidence_combined_r")) {
    raster_outputs$absence_evidence_combined <- absence_evidence_combined_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data <-
      euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data <-
      euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data <-
      euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data_r
  }

  if (exists("euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r")) {
    raster_outputs$euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data <-
      euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data_r
  }

  # 最終スコア
  if (exists("cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r")) {
    raster_outputs$cluster_continuity_score_all_cells <-
      cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r
  }

  if (exists("cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r")) {
    raster_outputs$cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only <-
      cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r
  }

  if (length(raster_outputs) == 0) {
    stop("出力対象ラスタがありません。build-final-continuity-score chunkを確認してください。")
  }

  for (nm in names(raster_outputs)) {
    out_path <- file.path(
      final_raster_dir,
      paste0("final_", nm, ".tif")
    )

    terra::writeRaster(
      raster_outputs[[nm]],
      out_path,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    cat("raster written:", out_path, "\n")
  }

  expected_final_rasters <- c(
    "final_euclidean_compact_score_no_data.tif",
    "final_absence_evidence_50m.tif",
    "final_absence_evidence_100m.tif",
    "final_absence_evidence_combined.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_soft_p2_score_no_data.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_soft_p4_score_no_data.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_hybrid_t25_score_no_data.tif",
    "final_euclidean_absence_hybrid_t35_score_no_data.tif",
    "final_cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only.tif"
  )

  raster_check <- tibble::tibble(
    file = expected_final_rasters,
    path = file.path(final_raster_dir, expected_final_rasters),
    exists = file.exists(file.path(final_raster_dir, expected_final_rasters))
  )

  print(raster_check)

  if (any(!raster_check$exists)) {
    warning(
      "不足しているfinal rasterがあります: ",
      paste(raster_check$file[!raster_check$exists], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}
```

# export-final-gpkg

**目的**：最終成果と中間検証レイヤをGeoPackageにまとめる。  
**達成指標**：final GPKGに `interim_` と `final_` レイヤが格納される。

```{r export-final-gpkg}
if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、final gpkg 出力をスキップします。")
  message("中間検証レイヤは export-interim-gpkg-layers で出力済みです。")
} else {
  if (file.exists(final_gpkg)) {
    unlink(final_gpkg)
  }

  # final出力時にもinterimレイヤを再書き出しし、GPKG再作成による消失を防ぐ。
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(dwelling_points_grouped_macro, final_gpkg, "interim_dwelling_points_grouped")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(group_geometries_interim, final_gpkg, "interim_group_geometries")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_group_geometries_interim, final_gpkg, "interim_macro_cluster_geometries")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_cluster_link_edges, final_gpkg, "interim_macro_cluster_link_edges")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(internal_void_candidates, final_gpkg, "interim_internal_void_candidates")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    grid10_status |>
      dplyr::select(grid_id, response, cell_status, dwelling_count, surveyed_ratio, surveyed_area_m2, cell_area_m2),
    final_gpkg,
    "interim_grid_status"
  )

  write_gpkg_layer_safe(dwelling_points_final, final_gpkg, "final_dwelling_points_with_support")
  write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_group_geometries_final, final_gpkg, "final_macro_cluster_isolation_support")

  final_grid_extract_points <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(grid10))

  extract_one_final_raster <- function(r, value_name) {
    r_tmp <- r
    names(r_tmp) <- value_name
    values_tmp <- terra::extract(r_tmp, terra::vect(final_grid_extract_points), ID = FALSE) |>
      tibble::as_tibble()
    values_tmp <- values_tmp[, 1, drop = FALSE]
    names(values_tmp) <- value_name
    values_tmp
  }

  final_grid_values <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    extract_one_final_raster(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r, "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"),
    extract_one_final_raster(cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r, "cluster_continuity_score_all_cells"),
    extract_one_final_raster(isolated_dwelling_signal_r, "isolated_dwelling_signal")
  )

  final_score_grid <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    grid10 |>
      dplyr::select(grid_id, response, cell_status, dwelling_count, surveyed_ratio),
    final_grid_values
  )

  final_score_grid_no_data <- final_score_grid |>
    dplyr::filter(
      cell_status == "no_data",
      !is.na(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only)
    )

  write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    final_score_grid_no_data,
    final_gpkg,
    "final_cluster_continuity_grid_no_data"
  )

  if (nrow(final_score_grid_no_data) > 0) {
    high_score_threshold <- stats::quantile(
      final_score_grid_no_data$cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only,
      0.95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    final_score_grid_no_data_high <- final_score_grid_no_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only >= high_score_threshold
      )

    write_gpkg_layer_safe(
      final_score_grid_no_data_high,
      final_gpkg,
      "final_cluster_continuity_grid_no_data_top5pct"
    )
  }

  cat("final gpkg:", final_gpkg, "\n")
}
```

# final-summaries

**目的**：最終成果のCSV要約を出力する。  
**達成指標**：finalモデル実行時に、final scoreとmacro supportの要約CSVが作成される。

```{r final-summaries}
if (!proceed_to_final_model) {
  message("proceed_to_final_model = FALSE のため、final summary 出力をスキップします。")
} else {
  final_no_data_summary <- final_score_grid_no_data |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_no_data_cells = dplyr::n(),
      score_min = min(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, na.rm = TRUE),
      score_q25 = stats::quantile(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      score_median = stats::median(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, na.rm = TRUE),
      score_q75 = stats::quantile(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      score_q95 = stats::quantile(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      score_max = max(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  print(final_no_data_summary)

  readr::write_csv(
    final_no_data_summary,
    file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_no_data_score_summary.csv")
  )
}
```

# chunk-list

**目的**：Rmd全体のchunk構成を確認するため、chunk名と概要を一覧化する。  
**達成指標**：各chunkの役割が1文で把握できる。

| chunk名 | 概要 |
|---|---|
| `setup` | 解析に必要なパッケージと共通関数を準備する。 |
| `paths` | 入力ファイルと出力フォルダ構成を定義する。 |
| `analysis-parameters` | グリッドサイズ、孤立・密集判定、final実行可否を設定する。 |
| `download-data` | 入力GPKGが存在しない場合に取得する。 |
| `read-data` | 住居点、調査区、市域ポリゴンを読み込む。 |
| `create-analysis-grid` | 市域から10mグリッドとラスタテンプレートを作成する。 |
| `assign-grid-response` | 各グリッドセルにpresence/absence/no_dataを付与する。 |
| `rasterize-status-layers` | 状態別の面積・フラグをラスタ化する。 |
| `local-context-rasters` | absence penalty と open no_data score を作成する。 |
| `dwelling-neighbor-distances` | 住居間距離を算出し、DBSCAN候補パラメータを準備する。 |
| `parameter-sweep-clustering` | DBSCAN候補パラメータを評価する。 |
| `select-candidate-parameters` | 検証用の初期パラメータと通常隣接距離を選択する。 |
| `build-interim-micro-cluster-layers` | 住居点をmicro clusterへ分類し、中間確認用レイヤを作成する。 |
| `build-interim-macro-cluster-groups` | micro cluster間関係からmacro clusterと内部空白域候補を作成する。 |
| `export-interim-rasters` | 中間検証用ラスタをGeoTIFFとして出力する。 |
| `export-interim-gpkg-layers` | 中間検証用ベクタレイヤをGPKGに出力する。 |
| `check-interim-outputs` | 中間検証出力のCSV・ラスタ・GPKGレイヤの過不足を確認する。 |
| `final-validation-gate` | finalモデルへ進むかどうかを明示的に制御する。 |
| `compute-macro-isolation-support` | macro cluster単位で孤立度と集落連続性支持度を計算する。 |
| `build-supported-rasters` | macro cluster supportに基づく近接・密度・open no_data成分を作る。 |
| `build-final-continuity-score` | 連続量の自己相関スコアを作成する。 |
| `export-final-rasters` | final成果ラスタをGeoTIFFで出力する。 |
| `export-final-gpkg` | final成果とinterimレイヤをGPKGにまとめる。 |
| `final-summaries` | final成果の要約CSVを作成する。 |
